key_insight: Fed-GRPO enables federated reinforcement-learning fine-tuning for LLM reasoning by using reward statistics themselves to drive aggregation, calibration, and communication.
engineering_relevance: It offers a privacy-preserving training framework that reduces communication load while retaining much of the performance of centralized GRPO for distributed AI systems.
method: Signal-weighted aggregation: clients with higher reward standard deviation receive more influence.
Global reward calibration: local objectives are reweighted using the local-global reward gap to target weaknesses.
Adaptive sparse communication: bandwidth is allocated according to how informative each client's update is.
evidence_signal: On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, the method outperforms other federated baselines, approaches centralized training, and achieves up to 32× communication reduction with graceful degradation even under 621× compression.
watch_item: Performance depends on the reliability of reward statistics, so noisy or unstable rewards could affect weighting, calibration, and sparse communication decisions.
paper_title: Fed-GRPO: Reward-Signal-Driven Federated Group Relative Policy Optimization
